patterns: Direct single-fact items: which House the Estimates Committee is drawn from (Lok Sabha only), nicknames (Petitions = Ombudsman, PAC = watchdog).
APPSC links Estimates Committee to 'financial control reforms' - asks the purpose, not the strength numbers.
UPSC-style multi-statement on DRSCs reviewing regulators; app over-tests strength/quorum numbers and current JPC lists.
Traps: Estimates has no RS member and ruling-party chair; PAC Opposition chair is convention, not rule.
